policy.new_capability_rule: Every new capability must map to an existing claim or introduce a new falsifiable claim before it is treated as research-relevant.
policy.review_policy: Reviewers must check that every claim remains falsifiable, evidence status is bounded by observed evidence, proof references resolve, and schema compatibility is preserved.

claim:paphos-firmware-cycle.falsifier: After deploy, a staged kernel or pending capsule is not booted within a day, or the journal shows 'Outside of configured reboot window, skipping.' at a 05:00 run.
claim:paphos-firmware-cycle.statement: paphos applies LVFS firmware at 04:30 and reboots for a pending capsule at 06:00 inside its window, and its upgrade reboots land inside 05:00-06:30.

claim:paphos-unattended-unlock.falsifier: After enrollment and an upgrade reboot, paphos waits for the passphrase on initrd SSH port 2222.
claim:paphos-unattended-unlock.statement: After Tang enrollment, paphos reboots in its 05:00-06:30 window and unlocks its LUKS root without a passphrase.

claim:replace-template-claim:question:pr.decision_impact: Determines the first repository-specific research claim and its required proof.

Drop the decapod input's follows so den's package is upstream's exact cached derivation; trust the cache and its key on M-02877 and in mahakala's Home Manager NIX_CONFIG; move decapod to the latest release (0.137.2, upstream 53a5574) with its entrypoints and Dockerfile.decapod; fix the review findings on den #147.

active_boundaries: Current claimed task and isolated work branch
Only the decapod input (follows, lock), the cache declarations for M-02877 and mahakala, and the spec text about them and about den #147

observations: decapod.cachix.org (public, key decapod.cachix.org-1:AF1GjlAzLHQln1avulS5PZZMj0H9ftSFpTNz6mHg/ng=) has v0.136.3 for aarch64-darwin (w6s05i2…) and x86_64-linux (k0nxbq78…); not aarch64-linux. Den's follows build mlai9353… was not in it. After dropping follows, nix flake lock set decapod/rust-overlay to the newest 89750a2; set to upstream's locked 32346a8 by hand, nix flake lock then a no-op; no root input's locked source changed. Den's decapod (alone and in M-02877 home.packages) = /nix/store/w6s05i2hl1nfjhv7yj7a9xakpn6fw671-decapod-0.136.3; nix build fetched it from https://decapod.cachix.org in 2 s (10.06 MiB), sig decapod.cachix.org-1:W39x…, binary reports 0.136.3. Probe: nix flake update decapod -> 57a05bb (0.137.1) with decapod/rust-overlay 32346a8 = upstream's lock. 0.137.0 notes list guarded storage migrations, so 0.137.x is a separate cutover. workspace ensure with PATH 0.136.2 had rewritten the entrypoints to 0.136.2; restored from main.

Rebased onto d59d2ac (#148). Conflicts in config.toml, governance.json, .manifest.json and flake.lock resolved by the den precedent (main's config/manifest/lock, this branch's governance). nix flake lock re-added decapod's own nixpkgs and rust-overlay; rust-overlay set to upstream's 32346a8 again; no root input's locked source changed vs main. Den's decapod = /nix/store/w6s05i2hl1nfjhv7yj7a9xakpn6fw671-decapod-0.136.3 (upstream cached).

pr-reviewer on #149 (3 non-blocking notes) addressed in text: (1) OPERATIONS.md says nothing checks the decapod/rust-overlay pin, how to re-pin and how to check (reviewer's documented alternative to a guard; a wrong pin costs only a local build, and nix flake update decapod re-pins by itself); (2) darwin.nix and ARCHITECTURE.md say the key is trusted host-wide, while mahakala's is per invocation; (3) flake.nix and ARCHITECTURE.md qualify the nixpkgs cost: decapod/nixpkgs and decapod-g5/nixpkgs are both b6018f8 (one tree), and upstream's lock at 57a05bb (0.137.1) also pins b6018f8 and rust-overlay 32346a8.

Reconciliation after the #149 review edits: of 47 discovered sources only Justfile (mahakala cache variables), flake.lock (decapod nodes) and flake.nix (decapod input and comment) differ from main; no workflow changed; command contract digest 5d333049 unchanged; config.toml differs from main only in reviewed_sources_digest, renewed to agent.init's inventory digest d9e1b80c.

Tao: no narrowed trust (mahakala same as any host) and latest wherever possible. nix flake update decapod -> 53a5574 (v0.137.2) with nixpkgs b6018f8, rust-overlay 32346a8, flake-utils 11707dc = upstream's lock (no hand pin); outPath /nix/store/w7h10arrygsb7l2pif1v78nnkcphsawz-decapod-0.137.2 is in decapod.cachix.org and nix fetched it with the decapod.cachix.org-1 signature. Copy test of the live store: 0.137.2 migrated it (110 -> 104 objects, integrity ok, schema_version 18 unchanged); 0.136.2 then read 105 tasks and wrote (session acquire, todo add, todo claim); 0.137.2 reopened with no error; older releases re-create 4 indexes. Same test passed with 0.137.1. Isolated init with 0.137.2 changed only the 4 entrypoints and Dockerfile.decapod. Backup decapod-pre-0.137.2-20261111T082519Z.db (132100096 bytes, mode 0600, integrity ok, 110 objects) before 0.137.2 first opened the shared store. ghcr v0.137.2-debian pending (upstream Release run in progress).
